angle: WR/TE break mechanics from Combine route drills (Break G: push into the ground over the one second around the first cut; brake, speed through, drive out as parts) graded by the same code on matched NFL route families (slant/out/hitch/in/corner), tested against full-season separation over expected on held-out draft classes; why it fails (entry speed); drill protocol; day-3 SOE shortcut tested and rejected.
metric_name: Break G: on the first real cut of a route, how hard the receiver pushes into the ground over the one second around the break, in g (1 sd = 0.021 g); z within drill and Combine year, averaged over route drills and shrunk by each receiver's reliability. Film proxy: speed shed into the plant (rep-level rank corr. 0.70).
headline_number: -1.2 in of season SOE per sd of true Break G [90%: -3.8, +1.0], n=116 receivers, held-out draft classes; inclusion-weighted -1.1 [-3.3, +0.9]; no-tracking benchmarks 3-cone -0.5 [-6.3, +3.5] (n=38), shuttle -1.0 [-4.4, +2.3] (n=45); 0 of 8 slopes exclude zero; 68% power at +/-3 in, 80% only for 3.5 in. Transfer: 40 -> NFL top speed 0.48 [0.35, 0.60] vs Combine -> NFL Break G -0.04 [-0.22, 0.14], n=92; 47 of 49 WRs enter the drill cut faster than the NFL cut.
what_changed_from_previous: Revision of round_20/revised applying all four judges' top_changes. Writeup: single-clause title; one-line coach-repeatable Break G definition under the bold finding with a film proxy (speed shed into the plant, rho 0.70, 885 reps); Section 1 table cut to 4 rows (robustness rows to appendix.md); Section 2 table exactly the 4 requested rows; Section 4 is two sentences; power sentence '68% at +/-3 in; 80% only for 3.5 in'; -3.8 used everywhere (the ICC-propagated -3.6 interval moved to the appendix); 1,318 words (was ~1,865), 3 figures + 3 tables (was 5 figures + 3 tables). Football: new named table of drill vs NFL cut speeds (in -> slowest -> out) for Boutte (#1), Flournoy (#25), Bobo (#49); entry-speed mechanism quantified (47 of 49 enter the drill cut faster); decisive close. Data science: day-3 evidence pooled to receiver level (38 pairs, 28 receivers, 50+ routes, LOCO forecasts, receiver-cluster bootstrap) against a bar fixed before the pooled run (+10 points, lower bound > 0): SOE half 42% vs pick half 63%, -21 [-43, 0], so the separation-ordered list is dropped from the body (names, flip points and man/zone, slot/wide splits with cell n kept in the appendix as a coin-flip film aid); no-tracking benchmarks (official 3-cone and short shuttle) added to both the season test and the transfer test; ridge-logistic inverse-probability weights for reaching NFL routes (116 of 149), refit in each resample; multiplicity count (0 of 8); verify.py now uses its own seeds (tolerance 15% of interval width, largest drift reported: 11%) and a second statsmodels LOCO implementation that must match the numpy slope; 100 of 100 checked numbers reproduce (55 exact). Viz: hero Fig 1 = six receivers at evenly spaced Break G ranks with every drill rep and NFL break overlaid as thin speed traces, medians bold, graded second shaded, entry speeds in panel subtitles, no SOE clutter; Fig 2 = forest alone with tracking vs no-tracking rows and n per row; Fig 3 = speed vs cut scatters plus protocol/agility transfer panel (old Fig 4B merged) with a dark neutral dashed reference; reliability curve moved to the appendix; queue figure removed with the list.
open_risks: Still a null-result paper; the re-stem-at-NFL-speed prescription cannot be tested here (4 of 265 hitch-family reps are entered near NFL speed).
Power is 68% at the pre-set 3-inch margin (MDE 3.5 in) and harm is not excluded (lower bound -3.8).

Dropping the day-3 film queue from the body may cost Football 'usable' points; the judges asked both for full queue detail (Football) and for dropping it if it fails a bar (DataScience) - this candidate follows the pre-stated bar.
Bar and pooled day-3 test were defined after the 100-route back-test had been seen; 'fixed before the pooled run' is weaker than pre-registration.
No-tracking agility benchmarks rest on few receivers (3-cone 38, shuttle 45); the film proxy (speed shed) is a correlate of Break G, not a replacement.
NFL-side numbers (transfer, Fig 1, Fig 3, named table) rest on sampled plays (up to 40 per player, half top-EPA).
